name: motion-spring-vs-tween
title: Spring vs Tween
description: Bài học: vật có khối lượng dùng lò xo, còn chữ và máy quay dùng tween có thời lượng định sẵn (Bézier).

moworks.notes: Two squares travel 220 px from the same start: 'tween' in 500 ms expo.out (cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)), 'spring' on k 200, c 14 (16.7 % overshoot, settles ~620 ms). Recipe: objects spring(260, 20), text 500 ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1). Rule: springs for objects with mass, timed béziers for text and cameras (no overshoot on text). Params: tween (0.5 s expo.out) · spring (k 200, c 14) · distance (220 px). The lesson: springs for objects with mass, timed Béziers for text and cameras (no overshoot on text).
